lines.text: The people wept and grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and said let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.
Joshua and Caleb tore their clothes and said the land was good, but the congregation threatened to stone them.
The LORD said He would strike the people with a plague, but Moses pleaded and the LORD pardoned them.
The LORD said Caleb would enter the land, and the people would bear their guilt forty months in the wilderness.
The people went up the ridge anyway, and the Amalekites and Canaanites routed them all the way to Jericho.
